description: Claude Code /resume session picker: a ❯-highlighted cursor list with NO per-row digits, a search box, and a footer of bindings. The trap is scoring this 'menu' — a digit lands in the Search box instead of selecting, which is issue #206. Expected question with answer_style=cursor, waiting_on=user. The sample also pins the two fields the phone's cursor walk is STEERED by, because answer_style alone only proves the shape was recognized: `selected` is the anchor every move is computed from (a wrong one silently resumes the wrong session), and `keymap` is the whole set of keys the walk is allowed to press (an empty one leaves the phone with nothing to do but tell the user to reach for a keyboard). Worth knowing when this sample moves: the footer here spells out Type to search and Esc, but NOT ↑/↓/Enter — the keymap below is the ❯-list's universal convention, which the model reports consistently and the widget does honor. If a prompt edit ever makes the model strictly literal about the footer, this goes red, and that IS the alarm: the phone would quietly lose the ability to pick a row on the exact screen this feature exists for. Real screen (tmux-rc, 2026-09-17).
